senses.gloss:
m. (-हः)
A drum, a double drum.
E.
यशस् fame, and पटह a drum.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Dead, deceased.
m. (-षः)
Death, dying.
E.
यशस् fame, and शेष end.

n. (-शः)
1 Glory, fame, celebrity, reputation.
2 Splendour, lustre.
3 Praise, eulogium.
E.
अश to pervade, to spread abroad, aff. असुन, and युट् augment, substituted for the initial.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Rendering famous, conferring celebrity.
E.
यशस् fame, कृ to make, aff. टच्.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Ambitious, desirous of fame or glory.
E.
यशस्, and काम desire.

mfn. (-म्यन्-म्यती-म्यत)
Desiring fame or glory.
E.
यशस्, and काम्यत् desiring.

mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्)
Famous, celebrated.
E.
यशस् fame, मतुप् poss. aff.

mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि)
Famed, renowned, celebrated.
f. (-स्विनी)
Wild cotton.
E.
यशस् fame, and विनि aff.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Conferring fame.
E.
यशस्, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Destroying fame, rendering infamous.
E.
यशस्, and घ्न what destroys.

mf. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टी)
1 A staff, a stick.
2 A staff armed with iron, &c. used as a weapon, a club, a mace.
3 A necklace.
4 Any creeping plant.
5 Liquorice.
6 A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.)
7 A string, a thread, especially as strung with pearls, &c.
8 A thread in general.
m. (-ष्टिः)
1 A flag-staff.
2 The arm and forearm.
E.
यक्ष to worship, aff. क्तिन्, and the क of the compound final rejected.

m. (-कः)
A bird, the lapwing.
f. (-का)
1 A necklace, especially of but one string.
2 A pond, a pool.
3 Liquorice.
4 A club, a staff, a bludgeon.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-कः)
A warrior armed with a club.
E.
यष्टि a stick, a club, ठक् aff., and both vowels made long.

m. (-हः)
A club-bearer, one carrying a staff or stick.
E.
यष्टि a stick, and ग्रह to take, aff. अच्.

n. (-धु)
Liquorice, or the root of the Abrus precatorius, which is used for it.
E.
यष्टि a stick, and मधु honey; also with कन् added, fem. form यष्टिमधुका, and with the final of the first word long. यष्टीमधु.

m. (-ष्टा)
A sacrificer, one who employs priests for a sacrifice.
E.
यज to worship, aff. तृच्, and ज changed to ष.

(इर उ) इर् यसु r. 1st and 4th cls. (यसति यस्यति)
To endeavour, to persevere, to make strenuous and persevering exertion.
With आङ् prefixed,
To labour.
With निर्,
To exude.

m. (-सः)
A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.)
f. (-सा)
A sort of bird, the Sārikā.
E.
यस to endeavour, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
1 To be done with energy or perseverance.
2 To be killed or put to death.
E.
यस to strive यत् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Death, being killed.
2 Effort, energy.
E.
त्व added to the last.

m. (-यः)
The son of ŚĀKYAMUNI, the probable founder of the Bauddha sect.

mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्)
Going, who or what will be going.
E.
या to go, शतृ aff., with the future tense.
